_steps.what: Re-read (REREAD_BRIEF, batch b06): key corrected for all nine letters after kwic checks over the whole corpus: 38 = d (was g: feindt, und, landt, wurdt), Δ = nu (was e: warnung, hoffnung, nun, Nuncio), #dot = su (was null: sufficient, subsidia, verfassung, suspiciones), #s-long = ti (was t: militaria, resolution, obligation; glossed ti on R3811 p. 1), m = a (was null; after 29: quartier, quam, quando). Two polyphonic readings entered as relabelled signs: 9v = vo (the same 9 shape; Volck, von, vor, voluimus, darvon) and pv = vi (the crossed long-s; Salvius, resolviren, proviant, privilegia), relabelled in tr/ only where the other value gives no word. KEY.md updated.

Re-read b06: every letter checked on full-resolution crops of the DECODE images (main checkout img/; crops in the session scratchpad only, research/reading_audit/b06_crop.py); about 330 label and clear-text fixes logged in read/<rec>_corrections.tsv (φ for 6, #f-cross for p after 27, 9v, pv, regrouped figures, struck tokens turned into notes, clear Kurrent re-read, R4625 dated Hamburg 10 Feb 1639 from its p. 6). The R3811 interlinear decipherment transcribed in read/R3811_interlinear.md (it also settles 4 2 = 42, 9 = #sect, 0 = φ).
